article_title: The Rise of Open-Source AI Models in 2025

article_sections.heading: Introduction
article_sections.content: Open-source AI models have seen explosive growth over the past year, with new releases challenging proprietary giants across benchmarks.

article_sections.heading: Key Players
article_sections.content: Meta, Mistral, and a growing roster of startups have pushed the frontier of what open weights can achieve, particularly in coding and reasoning tasks.

article_sections.heading: What This Means for Developers
article_sections.content: Developers now have access to powerful models they can run locally, fine-tune, and deploy without usage-based billing — a paradigm shift for the industry.
